result.title: Learning to Decode Linear Codes with Generalized Belief Propagation Network
result.summary: Error correcting codes are a fundamental component of communication systems, enabling reliable data transmission over noisy channels. Recently, neural decoders have demonstrated notable performance gains over classical iterative algorithms. In this paper, we propose a Generalized Belief Propagation Network (GBPNet) that preserves message-passing symmetry while enhancing the decoder's learning capability. The architecture uses cascaded variable-node updates and learned element-wise message scaling while retaining the Tanner graph structure. We also introduce two training strategies, progressive training and high-SNR training, that improve decoding accuracy. Experimental results on several linear codes show that GBPNet achieves lower bit error rates than conventional belief propagation and the evaluated state-of-the-art neural decoders.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 GBPNet，在保留 Tanner 图消息传递对称性的前提下，用级联变量节点更新与可学习的逐元素消息缩放增强神经译码器，并引入渐进训练与高 SNR 训练两种策略，在多种线性码上取得更低误码率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其迭代消息传递中的状态更新、逐元素缩放与渐进／高信噪比训练，可能为 LVR 的循环推理状态更新与轨迹式监督提供可核查的借鉴线索，但领域为信道译码，与视觉推理无直接联系。
